python3 -c "
# Monthly Net Excise Taxes for FY 2018 (Oct 2017 - Sept 2018)
# From table column 'Net excise taxes (35)'
# These are already in millions of dollars

monthly_values = [
    7463,  # Oct 2017
    7240,  # Nov 2017
    6867,  # Dec 2017
    6168,  # Jan 2018
    5878,  # Feb 2018
    7849,  # Mar 2018
    6905,  # Apr 2018
    7325,  # May 2018
    7343,  # June 2018
    7716,  # July 2018
    8154,  # Aug 2018
    16079  # Sept 2018
]

# Calculate Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD)
# MAD = (1/n) * sum(|x_i - mean|)
import statistics
mean = statistics.mean(monthly_values)
print(f'Mean: {mean}')
mad = statistics.mean([abs(x - mean) for x in monthly_values])
print(f'MAD (unrounded): {mad}')
print(f'MAD rounded to thousandths: {round(mad, 3)}')
print()
print('Individual values:', monthly_values)
print('Count:', len(monthly_values))
"

print(f'Count: {n}')
"
